description: Beta distribution survival function 1 - I_x(a, b) on [0, 1]

tolerance.reason: 1 - I, with beta_cdf's tolerance for the same reasons (largest prefix logarithm 1.78e5 at a = b = 1e4). Computed as the complement 1 - I only where I is not close to 1, the upper tail keeps full relative precision, which this tolerance demands down to the smallest normal double. SciPy's worst error here is 1.0e-15, except at a = b = 1/2, x = 1e-20, where it returns 1 for 1 - (2/pi) 1e-10 (6.4e-11 off; the closed form confirms mpmath)
